hookId.description: The hook that gives the data, found or built: dugout_…. null only when no hook gives any of it and no connector could

built.description: true when you created or changed a hook in this run; false when you found one that fits

input.description: The inputs it ran with, as a page sends them

covers.description: What the design shows that it gives: `<the need's field, as the need writes it> → <path>`, the path from the root of the output, [] for each item of a list (team crest → matches[].teams[0].logo). `order → <path>` names the date the items are ordered by, `filterBy → <path>` the field that holds a page choice's option

missing.description: For people: what the design shows that it does not give, each line starting with the need's field as the need writes it, then why (`tickets link: no connector has it`), and anything else a person should know about the data

about.description: Whether the data is about what the need's must names, as you judge it from the data. Required when the need has a must and you answer with a hook

reading.description: design: the data is about the need's must; other: about another team or competition; unknown: the data does not say

why.description: What in the data says so (hook.evidence's names)
Found: why this hook over the others looked at. Built: which connector, and what the transform does. A line or two

created.description: What this run created in Cast, each as `provider <id> (<name>)`, `connector <id> (<name>)` or `hook <id> (<name>)`. Set by code from the run's own writes, never by you

basis.description: How the hook came to be this section's: built on feeds a person gave, a hook a person chose, found, or built. Set by code, never by you

existing.description: Only when you built a new hook after looking at another of dugout's: which one, and why it would not do
